description: PRD-260 (docs/PRDS/PRD-260-PLAY-THEME.md), one wave: T-001..T-010, T-002, T-005, T-007 and T-008 split in two so each story fits one session, in dependency order. Frontend only: no migration, no backend change, no new dependency. The seed has already cherry-picked cc08db61c, ad2d3fee7, 15c70c94d (-x, signed off), committed Auto's 36 clips under frontend/public/auto, and placed the READ-ONLY Play reference at scripts/ralph/prd260-spec/play-ref/ and the fonts at scripts/ralph/prd260-spec/play-fonts/ (untracked, never committed, never imported). Diff base for every check: `bash scripts/ralph/acceptance-prd260.sh --print-base`.
decisions: D1 (PRD §3, Gerard 14 Oct): lib/ui-style.ts gains 'play'; the automatos-style cookie can be play; the server renders <html class="studio play">: studio so pages without a Play design render Studio's version, play for Play's frame and the look's variables.

D2 (§3): useIsStudio() (hooks/use-studio-theme.ts) and the context's isStudio stay TRUE under Play, so every Studio page keeps rendering; a new useIsPlay() lets the frame and the Play-designed pages render Play's version.

D3 (§3): the look engine (ported from Play's lib/looks/) emits Play's own variables AND Studio's tokens (--background, --foreground, --card, --primary, --accent, --muted, --border, --ring and the rest, as HSL triplets), applied only under html.play, so Studio pages take the look's colours with no change to them.
D4 (§3): no flash — Play's pre-paint script (lib/looks/prepaint.ts) is rendered by app/layout.tsx only when the style is play.

D5 (§3): data comes from the core only — chat from lib/chat (useChatWithReceipts, the hook chat.tsx uses, which wraps useChat and adds the turn's receipts) and stores/chat-session-store.ts; Deliverables from hooks/use-deliverables-api.ts; history from lib/chat/api.ts getChatHistory/getChatMessages. Play's proxy routes, its api client and its stream parser are NOT ported.

D6 (§3): Auto is driven by Play's mascot reducer (lib/mascot/) fed from the core chat's events; the 12 clips ship under frontend/public/auto/ (webm, mp4, png per state; about 4.5 MB; committed by the seed). Rights settled (Higgsfield terms: ownership and commercial use; PRD-259 §10).

D7 (§3): phones (under 1024 px) stay as today — Studio is desktop-only and falls back, and Play does the same: Play's frame and Play's pages render only at >= 1024 px (useIsTabletOrBelow false); below, the existing fallback chrome renders.

D8 (§4): Play pages in this ship: Chat (/chat), Conversations (/conversations), Deliverables (/deliverables and its detail), Make it yours (/looks), the style sheet (/looks/style), the 404 and 'Automatos is asleep'. Everything else: Studio's version inside Play's frame, recoloured by the look.

D9 (§5): PRD-259 Wave 1's --radius (cc08db61c) and dark: (ad2d3fee7, 15c70c94d) fixes are cherry-picked by the seed (-x, signed off). PRD-259's skin format, tables and import are NOT part of this wave.

D10 (§6, Gerard's to revisit, not deferred by the kit): Play designs for Missions, Agents and Knowledge; phones; the Design Kit and the theme Marketplace; saving looks per user on the server — none are built here.
D11 (§7): Play stays opt-in (§7.1 is open: APPEARANCE_DEFAULTS_VERSION and DEFAULT_UI_STYLE are untouched, gate N17); 'Customise look…' in the theme menu is added (§7.2).

K1 (kit, 14 Oct): scripts/ralph/prd260-spec/play-ref/ is a READ-ONLY copy of automatos-play ralph/play-pages-a @1bf2940 (untracked in the worktree, never committed, never imported — gate N9/N11). Port into the core's own structure and style: kebab-case file names; lib/looks, lib/mascot, components/looks, components/mascot as the PRD names; Play-only screens under components/play/<area>/; hooks as hooks/use-*.ts; every backend call through the core's existing hooks and lib/chat/api.ts (apiClient underneath); React 18.2 (Play is 19.3: no ref-as-prop, no use()), react-markdown 9 (Play has 10).

K2 (kit): every Play CSS variable is renamed with the --pl- prefix (--accent → --pl-accent, --ground-bg → --pl-ground-bg, --motion → --pl-motion …). Measured 14 Oct: Play's --accent and --ring collide with Studio's HSL tokens of the same names (2 clashes of 159 Play names vs 77 in globals.css); the prefix is total so no clash can arise later. The look engine writes Studio's tokens under their own names beside the --pl- set. Gate N19 holds Play's CSS to --pl-* (plus --font-geist-sans/-mono, --font-newsreader, --radius).

K3 (kit): the look's values are inline custom properties on <html> (Play's own mechanism: the pre-paint script sets them before paint, and inline values outrank .studio and .studio.dark), set ONLY while the style is play; leaving Play removes every property the look set (LOOK_VAR_NAMES and STUDIO_TOKEN_NAMES), so Classic and Studio are exactly as before.

K4 (kit): under Play the tone follows the look's ground — Graphite, Obsidian and Night force Dark, Paper forces Light — through next-themes 0.2.1's forcedTheme on ThemeProvider (components/providers.tsx), which forces without overwriting the stored tone, so leaving Play restores the user's own tone. A cookie automatos-play-tone ('dark' | 'light', written by the LookProvider, parsed strictly) lets app/layout.tsx start forcedTheme on the server for the first paint (the pattern of PRD-259 W1's RVW-2 fix). The Tone items show disabled under Play with 'Set by your look'. Why: Studio's semantic tokens (destructive, success, warning, info, agent, chart, stage) and the now-live dark: classes must match the ground.

K5 (kit): Play's CSS ports as CSS Modules beside each component (*.module.css: Next 15 native, no dependency; vitest's css:false returns class-name proxies, so tests assert roles and text, never class names); Play's tokens and base rules (app/theme.css, app/globals.css of Play) become ONE global stylesheet frontend/app/play-theme.css imported by app/layout.tsx, where EVERY rule is under html.play. frontend/app/globals.css is not grown (3,398 lines on the base; gate N16).

K6 (kit): Play's display type — Instrument Serif 400 normal and italic, Bricolage Grotesque 700, Fredoka 600 — is vendored as the latin woff2 files staged in scripts/ralph/prd260-spec/play-fonts/ (copied with their OFL licences to frontend/app/fonts/play/) and loaded with next/font/local in frontend/app/play-fonts.ts (variables --pl-font-instrument-serif, --pl-font-bricolage, --pl-font-fredoka; preload: false, so Classic and Studio pay nothing). Geist and Geist Mono reuse the core's next/font variables (--font-geist-sans, --font-geist-mono): Play's literal 'Geist' family would not resolve, next/font renames it. Never next/font/google (the 7 Oct Turbopack trap; gate N18), never an @fontsource package (gate N5).

K7 (kit, the code-shape ratchet): ChatPage in app/chat/page.tsx is far over the 150-line component limit and MainLayout in components/layout/main-layout.tsx sits at it; scripts/check-changed-lines-eslint.js fails on ANY touched line inside a function over the limit. So Play's chat and Deliverables screens mount through the EXISTING app/chat/layout.tsx and app/deliverables/layout.tsx via one client component, components/play/play-route-switch.tsx (renders the Play screen instead of children when useIsPlay() and >= 1024 px and the pathname is the Play page; children otherwise), and MainLayout gains the Play frame only together with an extraction that leaves it under the limit. app/chat/page.tsx is not edited.

K8 (kit): a Deliverable's page is the core's existing /deliverables?deliverable=<id> (DeliverableDeepLink's shape, which chat links already use): no new /deliverables/[id] route. Under Play at >= 1024 px the switch shows Play's detail for that URL and DeliverableDeepLink stays closed.

K9 (kit): 'Customise look…' shows in the theme menu only while Play is the style (it never switches style by surprise). /looks and /looks/style under Classic or Studio render a short note with a 'Switch to Play' button (the menu's Play choice), never a redirect loop.
K10 (kit): /conversations is a new route; under Classic or Studio its server component redirects to /chat (reads the style cookie, no flash).

K11 (kit): the wave is frontend only — orchestrator/ and services/ untouched (gate N3), no migration (N1), no new dependency (N5, N6). Every route Play needs is already in route-manifest.json (/api/chat*, /api/deliverables*, /health, read 14 Oct). A story that cannot be built without a backend change replies RALPH_BLOCKED with the reason (Gerard decides).
One PR per wave: story commits end ' [skip ci]'; the runner opens the draft PR once when the build is COMPLETE; ONE CI run. Cut from origin/main; never merge anything into the branch.

userStories.title: Auto leaves thinking when Auto's words start: the core chat's reply text moves Auto from thinking to idle, as the standalone Play app does
userStories.description: As a Play user, I want Auto to stop thinking once his answer starts appearing, as in the standalone Play app (Play's mascot spec, play-ref/skills/mascot-states.md: 'If the state is thinking when the first delta arrives, go to idle'). The core's useChat forwards no text parts to onData (it writes the words into the reply), so T-003's mapping never fed the reducer's text event and Auto stayed thinking until the turn finished (gap found after T-010).
